cases.name: a-new-field-is-in-no-group-unless-its-draft-names-one
cases.covers: A designer whose own group is legal makes a field in no group, left out, null, or as one op of a change.

cases.name: naming-her-own-group-takes-no-right
cases.covers: Her own group takes no right, the buyer's takes fields:set-group she has, the seller's is Forbidden, by a create and an update.

cases.name: group-id-null-takes-a-field-out-of-its-group
cases.covers: null takes a field out of a group she has no right to assign, with form design alone; a field in none stays in none; back in is an assignment again.

cases.name: taking-a-field-out-of-its-group-takes-form-design
cases.covers: The seller, who may set the seller group but not design the form, is refused null by a verb and by a change.

cases.name: an-empty-group-id-is-refused
cases.covers: An empty id, by a create and an update, and one past 256 characters are InvalidArg, not no group.

cases.name: undo-puts-a-removed-group-back
cases.covers: Undo puts a removed group back and its undo takes it out again; undo takes an assigned group away and its undo puts it back.

cases.name: undo-of-a-group-change-holds-after-a-later-change
cases.covers: After a later change to the field, the undo puts the group back by value and keeps the later change.

cases.name: an-update-that-expects-no-group
cases.covers: expect: { groupId: null } on a field in a group is a ChangeConflict; on one in none it applies.

cases.name: a-copy-of-a-field-in-no-group-is-in-none
cases.covers: A copy of a field in no group is in none, of the buyer's keeps it; a copy of the seller's is Forbidden.
